description: Least-privilege permissions for the two content-protected notification panels: meeting and update. They need event subscription and nothing else: their remaining calls invoke this application's own commands, which the ACL does not gate. Until KNEG-168 these panels were absent from every capability, so they had no event permission and rendered nothing during a live recording. This capability deliberately grants only core:event:default, narrower than the dashboard and overlay's core:default; see default.json, docs/NETWORK_BOUNDARY.md, and docs/SECURITY.md.
